name: getCSPNonce
description: Returns the nonce that ColdFusion adds to the Content-Security-Policy header for the current request. Put it on inline script tags so the browser allows them to run.

params.name: returnAsString
params.description: true to return the value in nonce="..." attribute form, ready to place inside a script tag.

links.title: CSP Nonce Guide
links.description: How Content Security Policy nonces work and how to use them with script and style tags.
